newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 3.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Labour is planning to bring in a new regime whereby all offenders convicted of drug dealing, drug possession, burglary or theft will face testing for hard drugs and tough treatment programmes. At present one billion stg of goods are stolen every year in order to feed drug addiction.
TAX PROBE THREAT TO REUTERS' SHARE PLAN

Plans by Reuters to return 613 million stg to its investors via a revolutionary special dividend share are being investigated by the Inland Revenue. Inspectors could come down hard on the scheme if it is found to offer huge benefits to tax-exempt shareholders like pension funds.
JARDINE LOSES HK JOCKEY CLUB JOB

Jardine Fleming Investment Management has been sacked by the Hong Kong Jockey Club following recent regulatory action against the fund manager by Imro and Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission.
KPN SET TO PACK UP TNT'S FREIGHT ARM
KPN, the Dutch telecoms and post office giant which yesterday snapped up TNT for one billion stg, looks set to sell off TNT's general freight business.
OLIVETTI EYES SELL-OFFS TO BUY TIME FOR SURVIVAL BID
Robert Colaninno, Olivetti's new chief executive, is expected to announce today that the company intends to make a series of asset disposals in a bid for recovery.
